blocks.text: Screengrab from Senate of the Philippines / YouTube MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente “Tito” Sotto III has floated the idea of increasing the budget for the hygiene and medical needs of persons deprived of liberty (PDLs), especially women. During Wednesday’s discussions on the Department of Justice (DOJ) proposed budget for 2027, Sotto inquired on the sufficiency of the medical allowance allotted for check-ups and maintenance medications for PDLs. Sen. Francis Pangilinan, who endorsed the DOJ’s budget before the Senate floor, said that the “P30 allowance is extremely limited.” Sotto then inquired about hygienic needs of women PDLs. “Have […]...
